title: Ibn Sīnā, Kitāb al-ishārāt wa-l-tanbīhāt, al-juzʾ al-awwal (the logic), ed. J. Forget, Le livre des théorèmes et des avertissements (Leiden: Brill, 1892)

why_seated: Inference sorted into qiyās, istiqrāʾ and tamthīl outside the Latin line; the Qiyās of the Shifāʾ is declared absent (no commons edition: Cairo 1964 only).
verified_loci: the classification of arguments: qiyās, istiqrāʾ, tamthīl — 'اشارة الى القياس والاستقراء والتمثتيل' (text/isharat-i.ocr.txt)

research.study: Critique of Pure Inference (working draft v1.1) and The Production of Readers (#1767), §11.6 "the witnesses between"
research.for: the reception history of inference from the Peripatos to the machine: the commentators who name Aristotle's ἑταῖροι, the Latin handbooks, the early-modern refusals of the syllogism, the nineteenth-century rebuilds, and the traditions that reasoned about inference without the Organon
